item.title: BLACKPINK’s History-Making Accomplishments: A Timeline
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show! Today, we're celebrating the incredible journey of K-pop sensation BLACKPINK. It's hard to believe it's been a decade since their debut on August 8, 2016.
[Music transitions to a BLACKPINK song clip]
Host: Since then, the quartet - consisting of LISA, JENNIE, ROSÉ, and JISOO - has been making waves in the music industry, breaking records and pushing boundaries. They're the first K-pop girl group to perform and headline Coachella, the first Asian act to do so, and they've also set multiple Guinness World Records.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: But that's not all - they've surpassed Justin Bieber in YouTube subscribers and become the first artist to reach 100 million subscribers on the platform. Jennie shared with Grammy.com that these achievements are a result of their fans' unconditional support, saying, "It gives us more motivation to go further than we ever dreamed of."
[Music transitions to another BLACKPINK song clip]
Host: After taking some time apart to pursue solo projects, BLACKPINK is back and ready to take on the world with their DEADLINE World Tour and new album. As they mark a decade since their debut with single album Square One, featuring "Whistle" and "Boombayah", it's clear that this group is just getting started.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to our show! Join us next time for more updates on the world of K-pop and beyond.
